extracted.intended_audience: students and practitioners of classical geometry (undergraduate and advanced), historians of mathematics, and instructors
extracted.subtask_description: A scanned/typed edition of Euclid's Elements (first six books and 11–12, with Data and plane/spherical trigonometry), presenting definitions, postulates, axioms, and classical propositions with proofs. Useful as a primary-source textbook excerpt for learning or teaching classical Euclidean geometry and spherical trigonometry.
